jersey-law holds 11 Jersey Laws as official consolidations with in-force history from 2020-2021 onwards: 5 of the 7 essentials checked (not the States of Jersey Law 2005 or the Royal Court (Jersey) Law 1948), no Regulations or Orders as texts, and no case law. Its newest versions match jerseylaw.je's current versions and the wording checked matches, but PPCE Law Art. 28A has lost its paragraph (2) and Companies Law Art. 143D was merged into Art. 143C from 2026-06-24 to 2026-09-29.

Shares are of what exists, not of what each repository says it holds; estimates are marked, with their method in [data/completeness.json](../data/completeness.json).
